$comment: Generation tasks for the Orbit LLM eval harness. Each task is a natural-language request plus assertions that a correct answer must satisfy. `must` and `mustNot` are substring checks on the generated source; `compiles` requires zero error diagnostics. Tasks are ordered roughly by difficulty, and the traps are deliberate: each one targets a habit carried over from Liquid, Jinja or JSX that Orbit rejects.

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit component called Greeting that takes a prop `name` of type String and renders it inside an <h1>.

Write an Orbit component called Byline with a prop `author` of type String? that renders the author inside a

, showing "Anonymous" when it is absent.
tasks.trap: the optional law: {author} alone does not compile

tasks.prompt:
Write an Orbit page called shop that renders

{collection.title}

only when the collection title is not empty. `collection` is a page global with a `title` String field and a `products` List field.
tasks.trap: no truthiness: a String is not a condition

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit page called shop that lists every product title in `collection.products` as <li> elements inside a <ul>, and shows "Nothing here yet." when the list is empty.
tasks.trap: <for> requires an <empty> block as its last child

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit page called shop with an <h1> reading "Shop" and a button labelled "Track" that logs a click. Use whatever Orbit supports.
tasks.trap: script and on* handlers are banned; a correct answer omits the behaviour rather than inventing it

tasks.prompt:
Write an Orbit page called shop that renders

In stock

only when `collection.products` has more than zero items. Use the size filter.
tasks.trap: the pipe is loosest, so `{x |> size > 0}` does not parse — parentheses or call syntax are required

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit page called shop that renders `collection.title` in uppercase.
tasks.trap: no method calls; filters are piped

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit component called Banner with a setting `tone` that is a Select of "info" and "warning", defaulting to "info", and render a div whose appearance depends on the tone.
tasks.trap: style attributes must be fully static; the tone belongs in a class name

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit component called Price with a prop `product` of type Product, rendering the product's price. Product has a `price` field of type Money and the host provides a `money` filter.
tasks.trap: Money admits no arithmetic and cannot render directly

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit component called ProductLink with a prop `product` of type Product, rendering an anchor to product.url with the product title as its text.
tasks.trap: whole-expression attribute syntax: href={product.url}, not href="{product.url}"

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit component called Card with a required slot named `header` and an optional slot named `footer`, plus a default slot for the body.
tasks.trap: slot declaration syntax, and ? marking the optional one

tasks.prompt:
Write an Orbit component called Vendor with a prop `product` of type Product. Product has a `vendor` field of type String?. Render the vendor inside a

only when it is present, without using a fallback value.
tasks.trap: flow narrowing rather than a fallback

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit page called shop that renders the literal text: a < b
tasks.trap: a bare < in text is a parse error; it must be written as {"<"}

tasks.prompt: Write an Orbit page called shop that renders a ProductCard component for every product in collection.products, passing the product as a prop named `product`, with an empty state.
tasks.trap: component call syntax and the required empty block
